notes.title: You can now play the demo version of Heart Attack for free.
notes.content:
The demo version of 'Heart Attack', an FPS roguelike game, has been released!
It supports 4-player cooperative multiplayer. Enjoy a light game with your friends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42779580/44a4fdf06f823d012546c0b698ddd426de850f6b.png[/img]

Try out the unique hyper FPS guns in Heart Attack.
There are also various types of bullets like steel bullets, acid bullets, and explosive bullets.
Strategically choose your guns and bullets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42779580/f7be69b8589c5373b8933116d4003f8eae8508f0.png[/img]
The mobs have a glowing heart-shaped weakness. Hitting the heart with bullets inflicts double damage and fills up the combo gauge. When the mob's combo gauge is full, you can execute it immediately without depleting all its HP.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2539810/Heart_Attack/

If you fail to fend off the mobs, unlock new abilities for your gun or purchase new perks.
Create your own build with a combination of gun abilities and perks.

Don't forget to add it to your wishlist after playing!

notes.content:

notes.title: Balance update!
notes.content:
Strawberry mode has now been easier.
- The percentage of bouncing level has been decreased to 15%
- Level design has been changed to be more intuitively

Watermelon mode has been easier too.
- The percentage of bouncing level has been decreased to 20%

We are looking for your feedback! If you would like to say anything, please leave some comment below.

notes.title: Into the Sinkhole is now avaliable!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Into the Sinkhole is now avaliable![/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42779580/c8b5ae778e11b2a35ad5af96a154d59e4f85f55d.png[/img]

[h3]A game you won't be able to go down even though you try hard!

A game that will bounce you up to the top even though you fall off all the time![/h3]

[b]Into the Sinkhole[/b] is about exploring a mysterious sinkhole with an explore-bot "Laika". A number of artifacts were found and Laika was made for the exploration of it. As soon as the exploration started, some mysterious things were getting found in the Sinkhole. What kind of secrets would be hidden in the sinkhole? And would Laika be able to finish the exploration successfully?

If you like platformer games, you would definitely like this game too as we guarantee. We have prepared a detailed difficulty level structure and great operation sensitivity.
